story.head: Faulk reaches 500 points as the Red Wings beat the Senators
paras: William Wallinder played his first NHL game and picked up a point. Dylan Larkin played his first game of the season, after missing the first two. Tim Stützle opened the scoring for the Senators early in the first, but Alex DeBrincat tied it up for Detroit 32 seconds later. Larkin put the Red Wings ahead for good midway through the period. Viktor Arvidsson and Faulk scored two and a half minutes apart early in the second to make it 4-1. Drake Batherson cut Detroit’s lead to 4-2 on the power play less than two minutes later. William Eklund scored his first goal for Ottawa midway through the third to pull the Senators within one. DeBrincat struck again into the empty net with just under a minute left, with Justin Faulk picking up his 500th NHL point on the assist. There were two three-point nights: Lucas Raymond with three assists, and DeBrincat with two goals and an assist.
The Red Wings had a bit more of the good stuff, outshooting the Senators 36-25. John Gibson made 22 saves for the Wings, and Samuel Ersson stopped 31 of 35.
A scrum at the end of the second sent five players to the box. Ridly Greig took three penalties on his own. The Red Wings moved to 1-2-0, and the Senators fell to 2-1-0.

items.text: Lucas Raymond extended his point streak against Ottawa to eight games.
Two of the preview’s three calls held.
